name: 92231 · Calexico, CA
findings: ZIP 92231 (Calexico) has 44 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (23%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 7 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 92231 (Calexico) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 92231 (Calexico) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 29% of the typical level).
